raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Advance matching `.main.commit` and Megatron-LM gitlink from `3914483fd325e053797aff3fa431d4a3141139aa` to `6e7e6ed435e41af04fc41e7007ef862049153fdc`. The dev pin is unchanged.

[Upstream comparison](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/compare/3914483fd325e053797aff3fa431d4a3141139aa...6e7e6ed435e41af04fc41e7007ef862049153fdc) covers seven commits: MFSDP gradient dtype, checkpoint test seeding, wide-residual construction, owner-planning cleanup, batch-invariant mean correction, opt-in gradient-buffer offload, and inference checkpoint dequantization. No dependency metadata changes or Bridge adaptations were required during preparation; generated lockfile is unchanged.

Validation: CUDA-container `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` passed (345 packages), all-file pre-commit passed, matching pins, unchanged dev pin, and `git diff --check` passed. Current base main CICD NeMo run 38830191559 passed.

Requested CI: full L0/L1/L2 on H100 and GB200, with both full-suite labels. CICD NeMo run 38864821862 attempt 1 passed: H100 L0/L1/L2 31/27/17 jobs, GB200 13/21/13 jobs, and four unit jobs. Configure confirmed all requested tiers. Wheel build passed. Installation and release documentation failed on pre-existing main defects; overall validation and merge remain blocked.

Base repairs (October 16):
- **3. Bridge bug:** README news links outside the Sphinx source tree cause four missing-reference warnings. #6505 fixes these links; strict local Sphinx validation and independent review passed, CI and human review are pending.
- **3. Bridge bug:** #6492 added an unconditional Muse Spark import absent from the locked Transformers 5.19. Reuse #6490, whose Transformers 5.20 installation check imports all 899 modules successfully. It still needs the README repair through a main refresh, fresh checks, and human review.

Neither failure has a causal upstream Megatron-LM PR: both are present on the unchanged Bridge base. Keep this bump pin stable until the base repairs land, then refresh main and validate the new head with full CI.
